resources.string: No session saved on this device yet. Sign in on the official site, then paste the cookies here.
The session is only kept on this device. Verifying needs one real request.
The last request went through with the saved session.
Sending one real request to the official site. Tap to cancel.
The session may have expired, or the account hit a limit. Sign in again and paste new cookies. Previous models were kept.
Open the official site to sign in
Signing in inside the browser does not sync the session here. After signing in, copy the cookie header or the cookie JSON and paste it below.
Paste the cookie header or the browser cookie export. It is encrypted and stored on this device only.
These cookies cannot be used. Make sure they come from the official site and are still valid.
The text stays in this dialog only: switching away or closing it clears the input. It is never read from the clipboard automatically.
Sends one real request with the saved session and updates the model list on success.
Verification failed. The session may have expired or the account hit a limit; your previous models were kept.
Only the encrypted cookies on this device are deleted. The browser stays signed in and existing models are kept.
Not native function calling. The model asks for a tool through the prompt, every call needs your confirmation, and background sub-agents never get tools.
This is a prompt convention, not native function calling, and it does not add any model capability. Every tool call still needs your confirmation.
This first version is text only. Image input is not supported.
Leave it empty to use your personal organization. If the account belongs to several organizations, enter the UUID of the one you want; another organization is never picked for you.

Unofficial integration: it can stop working at any time or trigger account limits. Your messages are sent to the official service and may appear in the web history. The session is stored on this device only, is not backed up, and is deleted when you clear it or uninstall the app.
Claude\'s terms of service do not allow third parties to hold a web session on your behalf.
